sources.name: Onegram
sources.note: Official developer. The customized installation on this phone is protected from replacement.

sources.name: TIGI Software
sources.note: Official Filza archive. Jailbreak support packages require Cydia and may use system storage.

sources.name: VideoLAN
sources.note: Official source archive. App Store app availability is controlled by Apple; no random IPA mirrors.

sources.name: Libretro / RetroArch
sources.note: Official legacy IPA archive. Large download; this release has not been inspected by this catalog.

sources.name: Kodi
sources.note: Official legacy iOS packages. Package requirements must be reviewed; no automatic .deb execution.

sources.name: PPSSPP
sources.note: Official site explicitly says this Cydia repo is old and no longer updated. Review compatibility.

sources.name: Apple App Store
sources.note: Apple ID, previous purchases and older-version availability still apply. Open App Store cannot bypass them.

sources.name: Cydia / Telesphoreo
sources.note: Original Cydia source. Legacy HTTP transport; package manager trust and dependency checks still matter.

sources.name: BigBoss
sources.note: Long-standing Cydia repository. Legacy HTTP transport; site unreachable during this check. Not a direct-install source.

sources.name: Karen / Akemi
sources.note: Use only the developer releases. The repository endpoint was unreachable during this check; no signing changes are made here.

sources.name: Chariz
sources.note: Official marketplace. Many packages target newer iOS / ARM64; browsing does not establish iPhone 4s compatibility.

sources.name: Havoc
sources.note: Official marketplace. Primarily newer devices; do not assume its packages run on iOS 9.

sources.name: iPhone 4s Revival
sources.note: Public setup and Onegram notification notes. No app binaries are hosted in this repository.

sources.name: Computershik
sources.note: Developer legacy app and tweak repository, including Troubadour. Use List repo packages to import its 32-bit listings; Cydia resolves dependencies.

sources.name: LukeZGD
sources.note: Developer jailbreak utilities and legacy packages. Listings include tools and tweaks, not only GUI apps. Cydia installs after review.

sources.name: InvoxiPlayGames
sources.note: Developer legacy iOS fixes and utilities. Use List repo packages; index declarations alone do not prove service or device compatibility.
